verdict.rationale: Adyen documents PCI PTS 6 certified, PCI-compliant terminals, and the Terminal API has the Adyen-supplied terminal handle the shopper-card interaction, which implies card data stays on certified hardware rather than the developer's POS app. The pack does not explicitly state end-to-end encryption or P2PE, and has no guidance on the integrator's remaining PCI obligations. Missing for 10: explicit end-to-end/P2PE card-data encryption claims, vendor guidance on remaining merchant PCI obligations (e.g., SAQ type, scope reduction), independent corroboration.
